classes.name: MaintenanceService
classes.description: Service class for maintenance operations including security access strategies, data purge, and database handling.

methods.name: getPurgeableEntities
methods.description: Parses a YAML configuration file to retrieve purgeable entities for maintenance operations.

methods.name: getAccessStrategy
methods.description: Constructs and returns an appropriate AccessStrategy object based on class name, strategy, and strategy info.

methods.name: accessEmployeeData
methods.description: Retrieves employee data with respect to GDPR by applying configured access strategies within a transaction.

methods.description: Provides an instance of MaintenanceDao, initializing it if necessary.
